content.short: Maple is an institutional capital network built on Ethereum and Solana.
content.description: Maple is a DeFi protocol enabling undercollateralized lending to institutional borrowers and fixed-income opportunities for lenders. The Maple protocol began on the Ethereum mainnet on May 12, 2021, and has sourced over $72 million in USDC in institutional credit liquidity since then. By connecting institutional borrowers with lenders and promoting fixed-income exposure within digital assets, Maple expands the digital economy and aims to redefine capital markets.
